description: This file defines the 'Macro' class, which manages macro expressions for conditional content evaluation within a macro processing system. It contains logic for adding expressions, evaluating macros based on substitutions, and handling macro structure validation.

classes.name: Macro
classes.description: Container for macro expressions, supporting evaluation and validation of conditional macro logic.

methods.name: addExpression
methods.description: Adds a MacroExpression to the macro, ensuring only one main IF, one catch-all ELSE, and multiple ELSE-IF expressions are present.

methods.name: evaluateMacro
methods.description: Evaluates the macro expressions against a given Substitution, returning associated content of the first matching condition or null if none match.

methods.name: getSpanStart
methods.description: Returns the start position of the macro in the original buffer.

methods.name: setSpanStart
methods.description: Sets the start position of the macro in the buffer.

methods.name: getSpanEnd
methods.description: Returns the end position of the macro in the buffer.

methods.name: setSpanEnd
methods.description: Sets the end position of the macro in the buffer.

methods.name: validateMacro
methods.description: Validates that the macro has a main expression and defined span positions.
